SQL user lookup columns do not replace JSON identities. Native installed home/global resolution preserves every matching registration and cumulative scopes. Off mode retains the literal original SQL decode/resolver. TestScaleP21ApplicationAccess covers typed aliases/null/duplicates, native warm/reloaded output, complete by-value and User equality, cancellation, borrowed pool-one snapshot, output transfer and denial/latch cleanup.

ListApplications.reason: Bounded mode owns complete ordered installation outputs through BeginApplicationListRead and transfers the list owner through final response encoding, or returns coverage error. Native SQL workspace selection/order and JSON-derived home/client/user identity are retained, with explicit all-or-none failure and no live row cursor during nested reads. Off mode retains the original query/decode/resolver verbatim.
